_charter.job: DEVELOP phase. The user picks 1-3 sealed prereg(s) to actually build. The rest are NOT discarded — each becomes an unsown-seed artifact preserving its sealed sha256. The unsown-seeds land in archived_seeds/ for future planting. The picked ones move to active build under their frozen seal.
_charter.refuses: treating non-picked candidates as losses. They are SEEDS, not deletions. The sha256 makes them restartable — a future explorer can pull an archived seed and DEVELOP it without re-sealing (the seal is already valid).
apoha: NOT a reranking ('we picked the best') — a temporal-pickup ('we picked these to build NOW')
NOT re-opening the sealed triple (predict/kill/apoha are FROZEN)
NOT collapsing the unsown-set to a 'maybe-later list' — each carries its own seal-hash and is independently restartable
_charter.method: Input: full set of sealed-pre-regs from DEFINE. User selects 1-3 to develop. For each NON-selected: emit unsown-seed{candidate_id, sha256_pre_verdict, framing, predict, kill_condition, apoha, archived_at, reason_not_developed}. Persist in archived_seeds/<candidate_id>.json. For each SELECTED: execute the build under the sealed pre-reg's terms — no spec drift.

_note: Maps to miles's universal `solution-developer` phase-agent. The archival-vs-deletion discipline is lane-specific to idea-exploration; the underlying DEVELOP-phase shape is universal.
